'''Ōtomo no Inagimi''' (大伴 稲公), also known as '''Inakimi''' (稲君), was a {{ill|Nobility|en|Nobility|qid=Q134737|lt=noble}} of the {{ill|Nara period|en|Nara period|qid=Q189178|lt=Nara period}}. He was the son of {{ill|Otomo no Otomaro|ja|大伴安麻呂}} and served as Governor of {{ill|Yamato Province|en|Yamato Province|qid=Q907495|lt=Yamato Province}}. His court Rank was {{ill|Jushi-i|ja|従四位下|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade}}.

== Career ==
In 730 CE ({{ill|Tenpyō|br|Tenpyō|ca|Era Tenpyō|de|Tempyō|es|Tenpyō|fa|تنپیو|fr|Ère Tenpyō|ia|Tenpyo|id|Tempyō|it|Tenpyō|ja|天平|ko|덴표|no|Tenpyō|pt|Tenpyō|ru|Тэмпё|simple|Tenpyō|sr|Тенпјо|tr|Tenpyō|uk|Темпьо (ненґо)|zh|天平 (日本)|zh_yue|天平 (日本)|qid=Q1199879|lt=Tenpyō 2}}), Inagimi traveled to {{ill|Dazaifu (government)|en|Dazaifu (government)|qid=Q144845|lt=Dazaifu}} to visit his ailing elder brother, {{ill|Ōtomo no Tabito|en|Ōtomo no Tabito|qid=Q386287|lt=Ōtomo no Tabito}}, accompanied by {{ill|Ōtomo no Komaro|ja|大伴古麻呂|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtomo no Komaro|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11432332}}. At the time, he held the position of Assistant in the {{ill|Q11392842|ja|兵庫寮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hyōgoryō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11392842}} (Right Assistant of the Armory).<ref name="m1">{{Cite Man'yōshū|volume=4}}</ref>

Later, he served as a {{ill|Emonfu|ja|衛門府|ko|위문부|qid=Q11626338}} Captain ({{ill|Emon no Taifu|ja|衛門大尉}}) and composed a waka about {{ill|Q10866570|ja|三笠山|zh|三笠山|qid=Q10866570}}, which inspired a response poem from {{ill|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|ca|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|de|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|eo|Otomo-no Jakamoĉi|es|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|fa|اوتومو نو یاکاموچی|fi|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|fr|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|hi|ओतोमो याकामोचि|hy|Օտոմո Յակամուտի|it|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|ja|大伴家持|ko|오토모노 야카모치|pa|ਓਤੋਮੋ ਨੋ ਯਾਕਾਮੋਚੀ|pl|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|pt|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|ru|Отомо-но Якамоти|sh|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|sq|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|sv|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|tr|Ōtomo no Yakamochi|uk|Отомо но Якамоті|zh|大伴家持|qid=Q386308|lt=Ōtomo no Yakamochi}}.<ref name="m2">{{Cite Man'yōshū|volume=8}}</ref>

In 741 CE ({{ill|Tenpyō|br|Tenpyō|ca|Era Tenpyō|de|Tempyō|es|Tenpyō|fa|تنپیو|fr|Ère Tenpyō|ia|Tenpyo|id|Tempyō|it|Tenpyō|ja|天平|ko|덴표|no|Tenpyō|pt|Tenpyō|ru|Тэмпё|simple|Tenpyō|sr|Тенпјо|tr|Tenpyō|uk|Темпьо (ненґо)|zh|天平 (日本)|zh_yue|天平 (日本)|qid=Q1199879|lt=Tenpyō 13}}), he was appointed Governor of {{ill|Inaba Province|ja|Inaba Province}}, at which time he held the Rank of {{ill|Jugo-i no Ge|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}}. He was promoted several times in subsequent years, including:
- {{ill|Jugo-i no Jō|ja|従五位上|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}} in 743 CE.
- {{ill|Shogo-i no Ge|ja|正五位下|lt=Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} in 749 CE, when he also became Assistant Minister of the {{ill|Ministry of War (pre-modern Japan)|es|Ministerio de Asuntos Militares|fa|وزارت جنگ (ژاپن پیشامدرن)|ja|兵部省|ko|병부성|ru|Военное министерство Японии|uk|Міністерство війни Японії|vi|Binh Bộ Tỉnh (Nhật Bản)|zh|兵部省|qid=Q3276048|lt=Ministry of War}}.
- Governor of {{ill|Kazusa Province|cs|Provincie Kazusa|de|Provinz Kazusa|es|Provincia de Kazusa|fa|ولایت کازوسا|fr|Province de Kazusa|gl|Provincia de Kazusa|hak|Kazusa-koet|id|Provinsi Kazusa|it|Kazusa|ja|上総国|ko|가즈사국|lt|Kadzusos žemė|nl|Kazusa (provincie)|pt|Província de Kazusa|ru|Кадзуса (провинция)|simple|Kazusa Province|sk|Kazusa (provincia)|sr|Провинција Казуса|tr|Kazusa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Кадзуса|zh|上總國|zh_classical|上總國|zh_min_nan|Kazusa-kok|zh_yue|上總國|qid=Q1055394|lt=Kazusa Province}} in 754 CE.

In 757 CE, Inagimi was promoted to {{ill|Shogo-i no Jō|ja|正五位上|lt=Senior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}} in May. Following the suppression of the {{ill|Tachibana no Naramaro Rebellion|ja|橘奈良麻呂の乱}} in August of the same year, he was further elevated to {{ill|Jushi-i|ja|従四位下|lt=Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade}} for his contributions.

In 758 CE, while serving as Governor of Yamato Province, Inagimi reported the discovery of a set of 16 characters carved into the roots of a wisteria tree at {{ill|Mount Miwa|en|Mount Miwa|qid=Q860627|lt=Miwa Mountain}} in {{ill|Shikige district|ja|城下郡|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikijō District|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 式下郡|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11486987}}. These characters were interpreted as a divine affirmation of {{ill|Fujiwara no Nakamaro|en|Fujiwara no Nakamaro|qid=Q540305|lt=Fujiwara no Nakamaro}}'s governance.<ref>{{Cite Shoku Nihongi|date=Tenpyō Hōji 2, 27th day of the 2nd month}}</ref>
